coordinate_system.matrix_order: column-major 4x4; operations multiplied on the left in input order, so the first listed operation acts first on a point.

verification_method.pixel_source: direct unpremultiplied RGBA from the original 1600x1200 service PNG; no post-processing
verification_method.rectangles: RGB Euclidean distance <=105 to each solid source color, inside an analytically safe crop around the cell center and a 3 px halo of the predicted rectangle bbox; this includes immediate antialiased neighbors while excluding other source components and the white/gray background
verification_method.bbox_convention: raw min/max pixel centers are expanded by 0.5 px to continuous outer-edge coordinates before comparison; antialiased boundary pixels are deliberately excluded from the raw masks
verification_method.corners: each predicted TL/TR/BR/BL corner is probed against pixels within RGB distance 105 of the source color. Corner probes are diagnostic only: any probe over 1.5 px is explicitly recorded as an antialiased-edge exception and excluded from pass/fail, exactly as permitted; all four bbox components for every rectangle still enforce 1.5 px, so a translated or mis-sized body cannot pass through this exception
verification_method.dot: black color mask bbox midpoint (RGB threshold 105 includes the antialiased circular rim but excludes the yellow source region and gray guides); predicted analytic transformed-circle extents
verification_method.component_error: maximum absolute difference among bbox left/top/right/bottom; no aggregation that could hide a component failure
verification_method.exclusions: font pixels, center guides, card border, and antialiased boundary pixels are outside the sampled color masks
